video_caption: The video opens with a white background and a black rectangular frame. The title "Strategic Planning using Research & Analysis" is displayed at the top. Below this, an arrow points right to the text "QUALITATIVE & QUANTITATIVE", while a large black magnifying glass with "RESEARCH" written in red inside dominates the right side of the screen. A smaller magnifying glass is also visible in the top right corner. The scene then transitions to a wooden signpost with two arrows: one pointing right labeled "THIS WAY?" and another pointing left labeled "THAT WAY?". Below the signpost, a diverse group of cartoon people is gathered, along with a graph displaying an exponential curve and a colorful jumble of numbers. A woman in a yellow shirt and black skirt is seen speaking to a man, with speech bubbles showing "BLA...BLA.. ...BLA...", while a clipboard with checked and unchecked boxes lies on the ground. A large magnifying glass zooms in on the woman and man, then highlights the word "QUALITATIVE" in red, followed by "QUANTITATIVE DATA" in green, indicating different types of data collection. Finally, the scene changes to a hand writing "Learning goals for this video:" on a white background, with "Qualitative & Quantitative Research" as the main title and a small magnifying glass labeled "RESEARCH" in the top right corner.

The video segment opens with a white background enclosed by a hand-drawn black rectangular frame. At the top, the title "Qualitative & Quantitative Research" is displayed in black text, accompanied by a black magnifying glass icon with the word "RESEARCH" written inside its lens. Below the title, the text "Learning goals for this video:" appears. A hand holding a black pen enters the frame from the right and begins to write. First, a black graduation cap icon appears, and the pen writes the text "What is the connection ?" followed by "Research, Analysis, Strategic Planning" on the next line, indicating the first learning objective. Then, another black graduation cap icon appears, and the hand writes "- WHAT?" followed by "Qualitative & Quantitative Research / Data" on the next line. Subsequently, the pen writes "- WHY? (pros & cons)" (meaning "WHY? (advantages & disadvantages)") and then "- HOW?", detailing the subsequent learning objectives of the video.

A white background is present throughout the video segment. At the top left, a hand holding a black pen writes "Strategic Planning using Research & Analysis" in black text, with "Strategic Planning" appearing first, followed by "using Research & Analysis" being added next to it. Below this text, a hand-drawn signpost with two arrows pointing in opposite directions is shown. The top arrow points right and has "THIS WAY?" written on it in black text, while the bottom arrow points left and has "THAT WAY?" written on it. In the top right corner, a hand-drawn magnifying glass is depicted, with the word "RESEARCH" written inside it. As the segment progresses, a red crayon highlights the words "Research & Analysis" with an orange dotted line.

The video segment displays an animated infographic for strategic planning. Initially, two road signs pointing left and right say "THAT WAY?" and "THIS WAY?". Below these, a "SWOT" (Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats) matrix is visible within a white rectangle, with an arrow pointing to a "SUMMARIZE" box. To the right, another large frame outlines research processes including "SECONDARY & PRIMARY RESEARCH", "QUALITATIVE & QUANTITATIVE RESEARCH", and "DATA QUALITY VALIDITY & RELIABILITY", accompanied by a stack of papers and a magnifying glass. Further down, a third frame differentiates between "EXTERNAL" factors (including a map resembling Great Britain, "PEST" analysis, and "PORTER'S 5" forces) and "INTERNAL" factors (represented by a calculator). Two magnifying glasses with the text "RESEARCH" appear in the top and bottom right corners. At 0:06, a "TOWS" (Threats, Opportunities, Weaknesses, Strengths) matrix appears to the left of the SWOT matrix. An arrow then emerges, pointing from the "SWOT" matrix to the "TOWS" matrix, with the text "STRATEGIC OPTIONS" appearing above it, indicating the transition from SWOT to TOWS to generate strategic options. By 0:13, the letters 'S', 'W', 'O', and 'T' fill the respective cells of the TOWS matrix. Finally, at 0:17, the screen slightly zooms in, and the title "Strategic Planning using Research & Analysis" appears at the top center, with a "VideoScribe" watermark in the bottom right corner.

The video opens with a white background featuring the title "Planning using Research & Analysis" at the top left and a magnifying glass icon with the word "RESEARCH" inside at the top right. A hand with a black pen is actively drawing on the screen. It first draws two rectangular boxes below "SECONDARY & PRIMARY RESEARCH" and "DATA QUALITY VALIDITY & RELIABILITY" respectively. The hand then outlines an elliptical box around the text "QUALITATIVE & QUANTITATIVE RESEARCH," which appears as the narrator speaks about these types of research. A red arrow animates, pointing from the "SECONDARY & PRIMARY RESEARCH" box towards the "QUALITATIVE & QUANTITATIVE RESEARCH" ellipse, signifying a connection between the two concepts as the narrator continues to introduce the topic.

The video opens with a whimsical cartoon illustration of "The French Café," a two-story building with blue trim, outdoor seating, and baked goods displayed in its windows. To the left, a signpost points in two directions with arrows labeled "THIS WAY?" and "THAT WAY?", below which another sign reads "PROBLEM: DECREASING SALES" alongside a declining red graph. At the top, the question "How could the French Café find out what the customers want?" is displayed, accompanied by a magnifying glass icon containing the word "RESEARCH." An orange crayon then appears, writing "QUALITATIVE RESEARCH" on a blank banner above the cafe. As the crayon finishes writing, a new animated scene emerges next to the café, depicting a diverse group of about six people, including one in a wheelchair, seated around a rectangular table, engaged in a discussion. The crayon then continues writing below the "QUALITATIVE RESEARCH" banner, spelling out "FOCUS GROUP INTERVIEWS." Subsequently, thought bubbles appear above the heads of the people at the table, gradually filling with a mix of yellow smiley faces and a few frowny faces, suggesting a range of opinions and emotions regarding the cafe.

The video segment opens with a detailed illustration of "The French Café" on the left, featuring tables and chairs outside and baked goods visible through its windows, while the right side displays methods of qualitative research. Above, five people (four men and one woman) are seated around a table, engaged in what is labeled "FOCUS GROUP INTERVIEWS," indicated by a thought bubble containing various emotional faces. Below them, a woman in a yellow top and black skirt interviews a man in a white t-shirt and grey pants, accompanied by a speech bubble reading "BLA. BLA. BLA." and the text "1-ON-1 IN-DEPTH INTERVIEWS." A magnifying glass with "RESEARCH" inside is positioned at the bottom right. At the 0:07 mark, a pair of black eyeglasses appear, followed by the gradual appearance of the text "OBSERVE CUSTOMER BEHAVIOUR," with the magnifying glass moving to highlight "RESEARCH" within this new text. A moment later, a man wearing a black t-shirt and jeans appears, standing below the eyeglasses, as the magnifying glass circles around his head and body, symbolizing observation. At 0:25, a question emerges in the top left corner: "How could the French Café find out what the customers want?" (The question implies the purpose of the research methods shown). Simultaneously, a large orange crayon animates and highlights the "QUALITATIVE RESEARCH" banner, and a vertical white line appears, sectioning off the right side of the screen as if for new content.

The video segment opens with a whiteboard-style animation featuring a drawing of "The French Cafe" (English text) building on the left. Above it, the question "How could the French Café find out what the customers want?" (English text) is displayed. To the right of the cafe, an orange banner reads "QUALITATIVE RESEARCH" (English text), beneath which are illustrations of three methods: five cartoon people seated around a table with speech bubbles showing smiley faces above them, labeled "FOCUS GROUP INTERVIEWS" (English); a male and female figure standing and talking, labeled "1-ON-1 IN-DEPTH INTERVIEWS" (English); and a male figure in a black t-shirt looking through dark-rimmed glasses, labeled "OBSERVE CUSTOMER BEHAVIOUR" (English). On the far right, a large white frame is present, with a magnifying glass icon labeled "RESEARCH" (English) at its top right corner. A hand holding an orange crayon is seen writing the word "CHARACTERISTICS" (English text, partially visible as "CHARACTE") at the top of this white frame.

The video segment opens with a white background featuring a two-story cartoon illustration of "The French Café" on the left, with outdoor seating, umbrellas, and cakes visible in the window displays. Above the cafe, a green banner reads "QUANTITATIVE RESEARCH," and a magnifying glass with the word "RESEARCH" inside its lens is on the right side of the screen. At 0:04, a clipboard with checkboxes and a question mark appears to the right of the cafe. A green crayon then writes "QUESTIONNAIRE" next to the clipboard (0:06). Following this, a bullet point and text appear below, stating "* SET OF ANSWER OPTIONS TO CHOOSE BETWEEN" (0:07-0:10). The magnifying glass briefly disappears and reappears (0:16-0:20). A cupcake with a cherry on top then appears below the clipboard (0:21), and the green crayon writes "EXPERIMENT" next to it (0:23). Text follows, showing "* HOW MANY NEW CAKES SOLD?" (0:26-0:29), and a starburst with "NEW" appears on the cupcake (0:29). A pair of black eyeglasses then appears below the cupcake (0:30), and "OBSERVATIONS" is written next to them (0:32). A woman with dark skin and dark hair, wearing a white shirt and gray skirt, stands next to a menu board outside the cafe (0:34-0:36), and the text "* HOW MANY ENTER / WALK PAST?" is written (0:37-0:39). The woman disappears, leaving the menu board (0:40). Below the eyeglasses, "WWW." appears with "Google Analytics" below it (0:47-0:48). The text "* ONLINE BOOKING" is written (0:50-0:51), followed by "* MEASURE INTERACTIONS" (0:54-0:55). Finally, at 0:56, all the research method elements (clipboard, cupcake, eyeglasses, WWW/Google Analytics) shift slightly left, closer to the cafe. A large, blank white rectangular box appears on the right, and a green crayon begins writing "CHAR" on it (0:59-1:01).

At the start of the video segment, a hand holding a green marker is seen writing on a whiteboard on the right side of the screen. The text being written is "CAN BE COUNTED / MEASURED, IS QUANTIFIABLE" and is part of a list under the heading "CHARACTERISTICS". Below this, the hand then writes "CLOSED-ENDED QUESTIONS, PREDEFINED ANSWER OPTIONS", followed by "CAN BE REPRESENTATIVE AND OBJECTIVE", and finally, "CAN'T UNCOVER IN-DEPTH / DETAILED RESPONSE, IS RELATIVELY COSTLY". On the left side of the screen, there's a cartoon drawing of a two-story building labeled "The French Cafe" with outdoor tables and chairs. A green banner above the cafe reads "QUANTITATIVE RESEARCH". Below this banner and to the right of the cafe, several examples of quantitative research methods are listed: "QUESTIONNAIRE (* SET OF ANSWER OPTIONS TO CHOOSE BETWEEN)", "EXPERIMENT (* HOW MANY NEW CAKES SOLD?)", and "OBSERVATIONS (* HOW MANY ENTER / WALK PAST? * ONLINE BOOKING - MEASURE INTERACTION)", accompanied by icons representing each method (a clipboard, a cupcake, and glasses with "www. Google Analytics" below). A magnifying glass with the word "RESEARCH" inside it is visible at the top right corner. The bottom right corner displays the "VideoScribe" logo.

The video segment opens with a hand-drawn illustration of a quaint blue cafe named "The French Cafe" with outdoor seating, against a white background. Above the cafe, a banner initially displays "QUALITATIVE" in orange text, with "What is best?" written above it and a magnifying glass labeled "RESEARCH" to the right. A green crayon then animates, writing "QUANTITATIVE vs." in green on the left side of the banner, resulting in "QUANTITATIVE vs. QUALITATIVE." Simultaneously, a large black question mark appears above the banner, symbolizing the dilemma of choosing the best research method. Three white rectangular information boxes then appear from under the banner: the central box is filled by a hand writing "Information need?" below an 'i' icon, while an orange crayon fills the right box with "IN-DEPTH, DETAILED INSIGHTS?" below another 'i' icon. A green crayon then fills the left box with "REPRESENTATIVE, MEASURABLE DATA?" below a third 'i' icon, highlighting two different types of desired information. Finally, the hand adds "Available resources?" to the central box, accompanied by an hourglass icon representing time, a money bag icon representing budget, and a group of small stick figures representing personnel or human resources, emphasizing the practical considerations for research.

The video opens with a whiteboard animation showing a simple sketch of a building, possibly a cafe, with a question mark in a thought bubble above it. Text above the building asks, "What is best?" and below it, "QUANTITATIVE vs. QUALITATIVE." Three information bubbles with 'i' icons branch off from the main text: one on the left asks, "REPRESENTATIVE, MEASURABLE DATA?", one in the center asks, "Information need? Available resources?" (accompanied by an hourglass and a money bag icon), and one on the right asks, "IN-DEPTH, DETAILED INSIGHTS?". A magnifying glass with the word "RESEARCH" inside appears in the top right corner. As the speaker mentions combining qualitative and quantitative research, a green arrow pointing right and an orange arrow pointing left appear above the central text, forming a circular motion, and a hand with a black pen writes the word "COMBINATION" over these arrows.
